title: Add a child
subtitle: You own this profile. Only you decide who sees the reports.
invBanner: {educator} invited you with code {code}. You’ll see this access on the next step and confirm it yourself.
s1Sub: Enter them exactly as on the birth certificate.
pinflCap: 14 digits from the birth certificate. Stored encrypted and never shown again — not even to you.
pinflBad: A PINFL is 14 digits, starting with 1–6, with a real date inside. Check it against the birth certificate.
dobOk: Matches the date in the PINFL
dobBad: Doesn’t match the date in the PINFL
regionCap: Choose the region of the school, not your home: Presidential School seats are allocated by the region where the child studies.
schoolEmpty: Schools in this region aren’t listed yet. You can continue without one and add it later.
schoolError: We couldn’t load the list of schools.
s1Hint: Fix the marked fields to continue.
dobErrT: The date of birth doesn’t match the PINFL
dobErrB: The PINFL encodes a date of birth, and it differs from the one you entered. Check both against the birth certificate — you can’t continue until they match.
dobHint: Correct the date of birth to continue.
s2Sub: Each access and each consent is given separately. You can change them at any time.
shareOn: On. The tutor sees {name}’s results and error types — not the PINFL, your number or your other children. Access ends on its own when the term is up.
shareOff: Off. {educator} won’t see {name}’s results. You can grant access later under Access & consents.
shareNoteAll: You can switch it off at any time. You’ll be notified of every change.
noTutorB: You didn’t arrive through an invitation, so only you see {name}’s reports. If a tutor sends one, you’ll confirm it together with an end date.
consNote: Optional consents don’t affect anything else. You can withdraw any consent; if you delete the profile, the data is anonymised.
reqHint: Tick the required consent to continue.
ldSub: Making sure there’s no existing profile and the date of birth matches. A few seconds.
errBody: The connection dropped while checking the PINFL. What you entered is still on this page — nothing will be sent twice when you retry.
errMalformed: The PINFL doesn’t look right: it needs 14 digits with a real date of birth inside.
errValidation: Some fields aren’t filled in correctly. Check them and send again.
errConsent: Consent to data processing is needed to create a profile.
doneSub: Reports come straight to you. The profile is yours: if your child changes tutor, the history stays with them.
doneAlready: This child was already in your profile — nothing was duplicated.
accOwner: Owner · sees everything and manages access
accNoTutor: No tutor yet — you can grant access later.
nextB: We’ll let you know when the window opens for {grade}. {name} can take it at home or at the tutor’s.
dupTitle: This child already has a profile
dupBody: A profile with this PINFL was created earlier. The owner has been notified that someone tried to add the child again. For safety, we don’t show the owner’s name or number.
dupIf1: Someone in your family, such as your spouse, may have created the profile. Ask them to add you as a second parent.
dupIf2: If not, open an ownership dispute: a staff member checks the documents and contacts both sides.
dispBody: Nothing in the profile changes while we check. We’ll text the decision to {phone}.
disp1: The profile owner is asked to confirm their relationship to the child.
disp2: We may ask you for a copy of the birth certificate and a short call.
disp3: A decision is made within 5 working days.
revTitle: A staff member will check this profile
revBody: Your number already has 4 child profiles. To protect against fake registrations, a person reviews the fifth profile and any after it. This isn’t an error — you don’t need to do anything else.
revDataV: Saved. After the review you’ll continue from Access & consents.
linkedTitle: You already have access to this child
linkedBody: You’re already this child’s second parent — their page is in your list of children. No new profile is needed.
cantTitle: You can’t add a child from here
cantBody: A child can be added by a profile owner or by a parent who is just starting. You’re signed in as a second parent on someone else’s profile, a tutor or a staff member.
cantAsk: If the child needs adding, ask the owner of their profile, or contact support.
loadErrBody: We couldn’t load the list of regions. Check your connection and try again.
a1b: One child, one profile. The number is stored encrypted and never appears on any screen or report.
a2b: Your child’s position is calculated among children in the same region aiming for the same school.
a3b: Tutors can only invite; you grant access. Every access has an end date.
